instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a small single-storey office fit-out that will be exchanged with a civil consultant. The building geometry and room arrangement are already acceptable, but the file lacks the survey context needed for coordination. Preserve the office shell, internal partition, spaces, slab, and existing openings. Rename the level as the geospatial ground level and register the project in the Web Mercator survey context provided by the consultant, using the supplied eastings, northings, height, axis, and scale values. Record the survey coordination with revision code BONSAI-CLI-06 on the rooms and envelope elements.
